articles.title: Chris Hansen Buys Advertisements for His True Crime Streaming Platform Before Every Single Screening of A24's Primetime Movie
articles.summary: Chris Hansen, best known as the host of Dateline NBC’s To Catch a Predator series, has purchased advertisements for his streaming platform that will play before every single screening of A24’s upcoming film adaptation of his rise to fame, Primetime.
body: The Hollywood Reporter received exclusive footage of the trailer, which reportedly shows the host walking into a kitchen before greeting viewers with a familiar line: “I’m going to need everyone in the theater to take a seat right over there.”

“Now, there are more platforms than ever before where this disturbing crime is being committed. Join us undercover every day on my streaming network, TruBlu,” he says as a QR code pops up on the screen.

It’s safe to say that Hansen isn’t too keen on Primetime. The host notably turned down a preliminary screening of the film, as told by the man himself during an interview with Fox News where he accused A24 of asking him to sign a “very restrictive agreement” before he could sit down in the theater.

“The lawyers at A24 wanted me to sign away my rights to my name, image, and brand, essentially, as well as any potential legal rights that would come out of the movie,” he stated. “I couldn’t sign that, so they didn’t show me the film. I went all the way over there. … But who’s going to sign something like that?

articles.title: Portal-Like Shooter Splitgate Died Once, And It’s Dying Again … Kind Of
articles.summary: Some games just aren't long for this world, and that’s exactly the case with the Portal-like and Halo-like shooter Splitgate: Arena Reloaded, which is getting put on a form of life support starting in early September. Developer 1047 Games took to X on August 26 to announce the news.
body: "The reality is that neither game is generating enough revenue to support the ongoing cost of dedicated servers," 1047 Games said. "We have continued covering the costs because we wanted to give both games every opportunity to grow, but we have reached the point where that is no longer sustainable. We have loved working on these games, playing them, and building them with this community, and we wish we could continue supporting them."

Despite development ending for both games, 1047 Games said that neither one will simply get shut down. Instead, both Empulse and Splitgate: Arena Reloaded have been "reworked to support peer-to-peer play." So, starting September 3, the dedicated servers will go offline, and both games will be playable for the foreseeable future through a P2P server-hosting browser. This means that you'll only be able to find matches when other people are online and hosting games instead of relying on servers to find games for you.

This is exactly what happened with the first Splitgate in August 2025. Released in 2019, the dedicated servers went offline on August 29, 2025, and entered a similar peer-to-peer multiplayer environment.

articles.title: Ridley Scott Is Developing an Alien: Covenant Sequel With Michael Fassbender
articles.summary: Ridley Scott has confirmed he isn't done with the Alien franchise, as he's developing a sequel to Alien: Covenant. When speaking with the LA Times, Scott confirmed he is still developing a sequel to Alien: Covenant, one that would follow Michael Fassbender's character, David.
body: The end of Covenant teased that his story was far from over, but that follow-up film has been in development hell for nearly a decade. Covenant itself missed the mark financially, and then Fox was acquired by Disney, which likely caused all kinds of issues with the film's development. Still, the Alien IP is very active with FX's Alien: Earth series and 2024's Alien: Romulus, which was a big hit. There's also the highly-anticipated Alien: Isolation 2 on the horizon for gamers.

Ridley Scott had previously stated that he wanted to make a whole series of Alien prequels that lead into the original film, and his follow-up to Covenant would be one of many entries to build up to that. As of right now, it's unclear when Ridley Scott plans to break out the chestbursters again. He just released The Dog Stars, starring Jacob Elordi ( which IGN gave a 5 ), and has a Treasure Planet adaptation with Hugh Jackman set to begin filming in November, a Bee Gees project at Paramount, and a variety of original films in different stages of development.
points: Ridley Scott has confirmed he isn't done with the Alien franchise, as he's developing a sequel to Alien: Covenant.

articles.title: All The Goth Girlies Who Loved American McGee’s Alice Need To See This Game
articles.summary: Now that Gamescom has kicked off, a seemingly endless barrage of new game trailers are hitting social media, and it's easy for smaller projects to get lost in the shuffle.
body: In Cutout, players control Lena, a "child of the forest" who takes the form of a 2D paper doll. After discovering a pair of scissors--and tapping into her internal rage--Lena embarks on a quest through a grimdark fairytale world full of enemies whose limbs she can sever and attach to her own body, giving her unique powers. But there's a catch: Enemies can also steal Lena's limbs and use them against her in battle.
In addition to stealing various limbs for advantage in combat, players will also be faced with choices that will shape what kind of person Lena becomes.
"Will you claim what they denied you, or heal what they destroyed?" an unseen narrator asks in the game's trailer.

From the spooky-cute fairytale aesthetic to the surprisingly violent premise and even Lena's striped stockings, Cutout is definitely giving off major Alice vibes (with a dash of Little Nightmares in there, too). We'll likely never get another Alice game from American McGee (thanks, EA), but with Cutout on the way, fans of nightmarish fairytales finally have a spiritual successor to look forward to.

articles.title: Avengers: Endgame Encore Will Include Two Sneak Peeks at Doomsday, But There's a Catch
articles.summary: Two sneak peeks at Avengers: Doomsday are coming to screenings of Avengers: Endgame Encore, though one of them will only be included in certain showings. As per an August 25 press release from Disney UK, Avengers: Endgame Encore will include an “exclusive look” at Avengers: Doomsday.
body: In bigger news, an “additional sneak peek” of the upcoming flick will also be included at showings on IMAX and Infinity Vision-certified screens. Thus far, it’s unclear how much time this will add to those screenings, and it’s possible that this glimpse at Doomsday could be part of the pre-show previews and not the actual film itself. Either way, fans are split as to whether or not sitting through a three hour-long movie they’ve already seen is actually worth it.

Avengers director Joe Russo has said it’s “critically important” that Marvel Studios re-release the film in theaters, calling it an "opportunity to create a bridge from Endgame to Doomsday in a very unique way.”

"You don’t always get the chance to re-release because it costs money, so the fact that we can enhance the story of Doomsday by bridging it to Endgame and these characters that we worked with for years that we love so much, and continue their story: It’s a really unique opportunity,” he said.

articles.title: GTA 6 Wants You To Reconsider Doing What Everyone Does In Grand Theft Auto
articles.summary: A new deep dive has dropped with some fascinating takeaways from Rockstar Games on the most anticipated release of the year, Grand Theft Auto 6. We've learned a lot already, including a feature returning from San Andreas and how switching between the two protagonists works.
body: In the Autumn 2026 Issue of Dazed magazine, some Rockstar Games developers talked about what you can expect when GTA 6 drops this November. While you're probably looking forward to rampaging through Leonida as you'd do in just about every other GTA game, the team is really cautioning you from doing so.

Because GTA 6 puts a greater emphasis on visual feedback (especially regarding how activities like exercising impact protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos appearance) and the deeper relationships you can have between the two main characters and all the other characters, GTA 6 features a heightened realism that makes you think twice about what you do and how you do it.

articles.title: Unlike The Big Console Makers, Playdate Is Refunding You Those Tariff Fees
articles.summary: As with so many other companies, including video game console makers, Panic increased the price of its Playdate handheld when US President Donald Trump implemented sweeping tariffs.
body: Word of the refunds was emailed out to impacted customers recently. In the email, Panic explained how it had charged extra to compensate for its increased costs due to the tariffs, and that it had now received refunds from the government. With that money secured, it's automatically refunding the tariff amount--$12.36--to anyone who paid that surcharge, and the money should automatically end up in their accounts within the next few days.

This move is in marked contrast to companies like Sony, Nintendo, and Microsoft, among others. Although many companies have sidestepped addressing the possibility of tariff refunds directly, there have been instances of them touting the impact of those refunds on their financials: both Sony and Nintendo highlighted the positive impact on their revenue from suddenly having a bunch of free money show up in their bank accounts.

articles.title: David Fincher and Quentin Tarantino's Once Upon a Time in Hollywood Sequel Gets Official Release Update
articles.summary: Quentin Tarantino's Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is getting an official sequel, one not directed by Tarantino himself. Seven and Fight Club director David Fincher is helming it instead with a new story that focuses on Brad Pitt's stuntman character Cliff Booth.
body: The Adventures of Cliff Booth has been retitled The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth — for reasons unknown — and will make its Netflix debut on Dec. 23.

Fincher and Tarantino fans will get an early look at the film in November. Netflix reconfirmed an exclusive two-week run in IMAX theaters globally starting Nov. 25. So if you want to see what a Fincher-led sequel to Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood looks like on the biggest screen, you have a limited window.

Pitt will reprise his Best Supporting Actor Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth in the film. While the original film was set in 1969, the sequel will take place in 1977 in "a very different Hollywood," Netflix says. The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis, and Karren Karagulian. Fincher directed from a script written by Tarantino, the latter of which has not revealed his 10th and final film-directing project.
points: Quentin Tarantino's Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is getting an official sequel, one not directed by Tarantino himself.
Seven and Fight Club director David Fincher is helming it instead with a new story that focuses on Brad Pitt's stuntman character Cliff Booth.

articles.title: Lego Unveils Massive New Star Wars 6,130-Piece Set Inspired by the Empire Strikes Back
articles.summary: When it comes to Star Wars, Lego likes to go big. Three of Lego's biggest sets are Star Wars sets: The Lego Death Star, released in 2025, reigns supreme in sheer size with its 9,023-piece recreation of the Empire's super weapon.
body: With its 6,130-piece build, the Lego Star Wars Executor Super Star Destroyer set won't dethrone the other gargantuan Lego Star Wars sets, but it does set one new record. It's now "the longest Lego Star Wars brick-built model to date," the toy maker said.

The Lego Star Wars Executor Super Star Destroyer is based on the comically long flagship used by Darth Vader in Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back. The Lego version of Vader's Star Destroyer — which measures 19,000 meters long in Star Wars canon, Wookieepedia tells us — is an impressive 53.5 inches (136 cm) in length. To achieve this impressive feat, Lego says, the set's design team "engineered a Lego System core with slender Lego Technic outriggers that anchor the exterior panels, delivering strength without bulk."

articles.title: Dark Souls meets Weird West in Guns of Eschaton, and it's a refreshing FPS shake-up for the well-worn formula - even if it's a bit bloody hard
articles.summary: Look, I'll level with you: I was rubbish at Guns of Eschaton during my recent hands-on time. There are some very obvious reasons for that - it's a hard game that doesn't currently especially explain itself very well, for one.
body: And with the tutorial out the way, Guns of Eschaton shows even less mercy. Once you reach its first proper area (the game's action is split across multiple discrete locations, accessed via a spooky hub known as Hounds Camp), you've suddenly got to contend with multiple enemies attacking from all directions, some enemies charging in from around corners and others, unsportingly, sniping from afar. Most areas, including the Spaghetti Western sprawl of pueblos blanco that open the game, require you to locate and defeat a boss. And death is almost an inevitability until you attune yourself to Guns of Eschaton's ways.

And there's more! Weapon modifications are supposedly possible at certain branches in the story, so you might choose to strip away the Buffalo Rifle's handy scope attachment in order to invoke the spirit inside, essentially turning it into a powerful one-shot revolver. Further tweaks come via ammo mods that add multiplier effects to the likes of range damage and recoil. And that's on top of armour, and consumables like dynamite and throwing knives.

articles.title: Ubisoft’s Botched Release of Classic Might and Magic Game Was a Hilarious Blunder
articles.summary: For more than 25 years, Heroes of Might and Magic 3 has been one of the defining games in turn-based strategy. Players explore a fantasy world, gather resources, build up towns, recruit armies and develop powerful heroes before sending those forces into tactical grid-based battles.
body: So when Ubisoft announced that the complete version of Heroes of Might and Magic 3 was finally coming to Steam, longtime fans had plenty of reason to be excited. The announcement came during Gamescom Opening Night Live, where Ubisoft also revealed Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake. The remake is scheduled for 2027 and will rebuild the classic in 3D using Ubisoft’s Snowdrop engine. The original Heroes 3 Complete, meanwhile, was made available on Steam for $10.
There was just one problem: Ubisoft apparently forgot to include the game.

Players who bought Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Complete on Steam initially received a nearly empty download. Instead of the roughly 770 MB game, the package contained a 23.49 KB file that failed to launch properly.

Players who tried to start the game were greeted by an error message and a dummy executable that opened a Command Prompt window. One early Steam reviewer described the release as so broken that “they did not even include the game files.”
points: For more than 25 years, Heroes of Might and Magic 3 has been one of the defining games in turn-based strategy.

articles.title: How to vote in The Council in League Classic
articles.summary: The Council allows you to change how League Classic is played through the power of your votes. Players can vote in a community poll to express their thoughts on the current state of the game, which in turn will change the direction that League Classic will go.
body: However, the community poll is only open for a week, so if you're enjoying League Classic, it's important to make your voice heard. Here's how to vote in The Council in League Classic.

To participate in The Council community poll, make sure you're at least level 5 in League Classic, so you have voting power. Voting power will make your choices more impactful, and the only way to gain more voting power is to play more League Classic. You can increase your voting power by reaching level 15 and 25 on the Classic Progression Track, and purchasing the voting power boost on page three of Classic Pass: Act 1.

To vote in the community poll, open the League of Legends client, and select the "Classic" tab at the top. Then, click "The Council" box in the bottom right corner of the screen, which will open a pop-up containing the poll questions. This poll will close at 1 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, Sept. 2, so make sure to cast your vote before then!

articles.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy review
articles.summary: Putting 'legacy' in the title of your game naturally encourages considerations about what that legacy might be – and that, in turn, invites thoughts about its identity.
body: Let me tell you about one in particular. Walk towards one of the many big, ancient doors in Resonance, and you'll see a tiny circle appear. Get closer and it'll become a button prompt, telling you to press... guess. No, not that one. Not that, either. Nope. It's R3! That's your all-purpose squeeze-through-gaps button, your crawl-through-narrow-holes button, your investigate-trinkets button, your insert-spherical-key-into-receptacle button. Even your pick-up-and-throw-dropped-knife-at-advancing-enemy button. Which sounds mildly unhinged, but somehow fits this game perfectly. That's the double-A spirit right there.

Despite her career path, Sophia turns out to be rather less sneaky when dealing with human threats than Amicia. Instead, we get a new ingredient to Plague Tale's work-in-progress recipe: sword combat. Despite the almost total absence of stealth kills, I was reminded of Sucker Punch's Ghost duology in these skirmishes, with perhaps just a pinch of Hellblade – though Sophia's a markedly more flexible, agile fighter than Senua.

articles.title: Tim Curry, Red Alert 3 star and camp icon of stage and screen, dies aged 80
articles.summary: Tim Curry, the beloved English actor beloved for his pantheon of iconic, award-winning performances on stage, film, TV, and videogame screen, has died at the age of 80. First reported by TMZ, Curry died late Tuesday night at his home in Los Angeles.
body: Curry first carved his mark in the public consciousness as the cross-dressing pansexual mad scientist Dr. Frank-N-Furter in The Rocky Horror Show, the 1975 film adaptation of which still maintains a cult following as a midnight movie phenomenon. From there, he secured a decades-long list of cherished roles—as Darkness in Legend and Wadsworth in Clue; in The Hunt for Red October, Home Alone 2, and Spamalot; as Pennywise in It and acting as a piratical foil to Kermit the Frog in Muppet Treasure Island.

Powerfully flamboyant, artfully unhinged, and charmingly insidious, Curry extended his talents to live action and vocal performances in videogames as well. He played the titular role in Sierra's first and third Gabriel Knight point-and-click adventures, and later voiced characters in Brütal Legend and Dragon Age: Origins.

But he reached the pinnacle of his powers as Premier Anatoly Cherdenko in Command and Conquer: Red Alert 3, where he delivered what may very well be the single most triumphant line read in the history of acting. Nobody had ever before conveyed such a captivatingly absurd cocktail of energies while saying the word "space," and it's likely that no one ever will again.

body: Want to try the game before you pre-order? The Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta is August 28, 2026 at 10am PT to September 1, 2026 at 10am PT! Pre-load the beta on your Nintendo Switch 2:
Dive right into the action with Multiplayer modes, a playable Campaign mission, Ground War, and much more. Earn exclusive Beta rewards that carry over when the game officially launches!
#CallofDuty #ModernWarfare4
points: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases October 23, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2!

videos.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - PS5/PS5 Pro/Series X/S Tech Review - Superb On All Systems
videos.summary: Thanks to MSI for sponsoring this video. Purchase an eligible QD-OLED display and share your feedback for the chance to get a game code for Onimusha: Way of the Sword
body: Developer Asobo Studio returns with its most sumptuous looking adventure yet. Here the PS5 Pro gets the spotlight with boosted resolutions, PSSR support and slicker frame-rates than base PS5. The ability to unlock all versions to 120fps (barring Series S) is also hugely useful, and the recommend pick if you have a VRR display - and if not, there are plenty of other modes to choose from. Tom covers each in detail.
points: Purchase an eligible QD-OLED display and share your feedback for the chance to get a game code for Onimusha: Way of the Sword
